grading_rationale: 2 P1 CVEs (exceeds A/B threshold of 0), 7 P2 findings, 11 P3 findings. Meets C threshold (max_p1=2, max_p2=15). Active spec coverage 100% for workflow-engine (meets C min 40%).
skip_reason: Backend (http://localhost:3001) and Frontend (http://localhost:5173) services offline during audit window

escalations.title: Handlebars.js — Multiple JavaScript Injection / RCE Vulnerabilities
escalations.exploit_scenario: If work item descriptions or assessment templates are compiled through Handlebars with untrusted input, attacker achieves remote code execution with full Node.js process privileges.
escalations.escalation_reason: Arbitrary code execution in template processing — verify if work item content can be templated.

escalations.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution via Proto Schema Code Generation
escalations.exploit_scenario: Orchestrator: arbitrary code execution via crafted proto schemas. Portal/Backend: malicious OpenTelemetry exporter response triggers RCE.
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs; cd portal/Backend && npm update
escalations.escalation_reason: Supply chain vulnerability affecting infrastructure orchestrator — coordinated deployment patch required.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind spot over portal/ and platform/
p2_findings.detail: CLAUDE.md verification gate passes green even though 76 FRs (portal/) and 13 FRs (platform/) have zero enforced coverage. Two of three application specs are entirely unverified.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to support multiple scan directories; add two enforcer invocations targeting portal/ and platform/ to the verification gate.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate logger abstraction — shim wrapper over canonical
p2_findings.detail: Two logger files exist. workItemStore.ts imports canonical directly; all 8 other files import the shim. CLAUDE.md single-source-of-truth rule violated.
p2_findings.recommendation: Remove logger.ts shim; consolidate all imports to utils/logger.ts with a proper default export.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p2_findings.detail: 39 test cases for WorkItemDetailPage and 28 for WorkItemListPage split across 4 files from two independent agent runs. Maintenance burden; fixes must be applied in two places.
p2_findings.recommendation: Keep tests/pages/ variants (more recent/complete); delete root-level duplicates.

p2_findings.title: Three open dependency-linking plan delta items (api-types, seed, wrong test directory)
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-api-types: blocked_by field missing from portal API types; DependencyPicker.tsx uses 'as any' cast. FR-dependency-seed: No seed.ts in portal/Backend. FR-dependency-frontend-tests: Tests created in Source/Frontend instead of portal/Frontend.
p2_findings.recommendation: Route to TheATeam: add blocked_by to portal shared types, create seed.ts with idempotent seeding, move dependency tests to portal/Frontend/tests/.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS on Express route matching (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express path-to-regexp; cd portal/Backend && npm update express path-to-regexp
